about_short_description.short_description: Octane is a digital wallet for vehicles that streamlines payments for all vehicle related expenses.

product.name: Octane Digital Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet for vehicles that manages and streamlines payments for all vehicle-related expenses including fuel, oils, tires, batteries, and spare parts.

product.name: Fuel Payment and Monitoring System
product.description: A system that controls and monitors fuel payments using NFC technology, mandatory pump image capture, and consumption tracking to prevent fraud and manage fuel expenses.

product.name: Fleet Management Operations Platform
product.description: A live control panel for managing fleet operations including balance transfers, PIN resets, and recording out-of-system fuel transactions.

product.name: E-Invoicing System
product.description: An electronic invoicing system that generates consolidated invoices for fuel consumption with official government rates, available in weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly billing cycles.

product.name: On-Ground Operations Support
product.description: Dedicated account management and 24/7 call center support to assist fleet managers and drivers at fuel stations.
